I'm looking for an experienced Roblox Studio developer to build a new multiplayer collection/progression game.

### Reference

Please play **Steal An Egg** before applying.
[login to view URL]

* Multiplayer systems
* Satisfying gameplay, physics and interactions

* High-quality models
* UI and progression systems
* DataStore/save system
* Performance optimization
* Mobile/PC/console support
* Clean, modular code that makes future updates easy

* 1 polished biome
* Core gameplay loop
* Collection/rarity system
* Progression and upgrades
* Basic UI
* Saving
* Initial collectible set

More biomes, collectibles, events and mechanics will be added through future updates.

Payment can be split into milestones based on progress.

5. Your MVP price
